verdict.rationale: Alloy documents ongoing monitoring that generates alerts or investigations (alloy-docs-17). It also returns Source Workflow results in an evaluations[] array (alloy-docs-4) and sends webhooks when a watchlist updates (alloy-docs-5). None of this shows an analyst-facing view of what changed for a monitored customer between alerts, such as a diff or change history behind a new alert. These are adjacent monitoring and notification features, not the change-inspection capability itself.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can inspect what changed when a monitored customer produces a new alert
